files.description: Account sign-ups (300 rows, not in date order): account_id (whole number), signup_day (date as text, YYYY-MM-DD, between 2023 and 2025; no empty cells), channel (web, app, referral or partner; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent; about 2% empty), first_payment (amount with two decimals; about 5% empty).

task_text: Count the sign-ups for every calendar day from the earliest to the latest sign-up day, including days with no sign-ups (count 0). Identify each day by its Unix timestamp in seconds (midnight UTC). `result` should be a Series indexed by that number with the counts, in day order.
intended_computation: Build every day from 2023-01-05 to 2025-12-28 (1089 days), count the sign-ups per day (0 where none) and index the counts by the day's midnight UTC in seconds since 1970, ascending; counts add up to 300.

predicted_direction.reason: on 3.x the generated day range uses a coarser unit, so the integer cast divided by 10**9 is not Unix seconds

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 in package TASKS_M1; task text, card, naive solution, reference and predicted direction were prepared there.
